source: House rule (owner request 2026-10-09, docs/next/GOAL_SCRIBE.md): the Scribe rewrites a fallen hero into the story for gold, outside combat only. Price = base_gp + per_level_gp x level of the fallen hero. A potion of healing is 50 gp and a tier-1 fight drops 1d6-2d6 gp, so a level-1 revive costs half a potion. Payment (owner choice 2026-10-11, playtest 3): the fallen hero's own purse pays first, the requesting hero pays the rest.
